track_c.name_en: Track C: 8zHutter3 — Generative XML Factory (Generator + XML Logic + Transformational Patch-Filter)
track_c.name_sl: Tir C: 8zHutter3 — Generativna tovarna XML (Generator + XML logika + Preoblikovalni patch-filter)
architecture_stages: 1. Generative Semantic & Structural Predictor (Causal LLM / Formula-DAG Generator)
2. Deterministic MediaWiki/XML Automaton (0-bit templates, citations, entity & timestamp normalization)
3. Transformational Residual Patch-Filter (Rank-0 confirms generator prediction at ~0 bits; non-zero emits minimal context-mixed residual)
